description: Finish an upload started with begin_build_upload: unpacks the zip into a new version of the Title (it appears in the dashboard's version history) and waits up to ~100 s. Returns the version with a TestUrl to try it before players see it. deploy=true also puts it live for players on the Title's address and its idosgames.com page. If it is still unpacking when the call returns, poll get_build. Calling it again with the same build_id returns the same version (with deploy=true it deploys a version that is ready).

deploy.description: true = put this version live for players as soon as it is unpacked. Default false: only a test version.

label.description: Optional short name of the version shown in the history ("Added the shop").

title_id.description: Live TitleID (the same one passed to begin_build_upload).

name: finish_build_upload
title: Finish build upload
